page: Microsoft Azure E2s_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Esv7 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 2 vCPUs mapped to 1 physical Intel Xeon 6973P-C core with 2 threads per core. The processor operates at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz and includes a 480 MB L3 cache. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPUs, but it is Premium Storage capable.

Performance benchmarks reveal a strong single-core profile alongside weaker multi-core and memory bandwidth results. The single-core Geekbench score of 2222.0 and single-threaded gzip compression speed of 35.12 GB/sec rank in the top 25% of tested servers. However, multi-core performance is limited due to the 2-vCPU configuration, with the stress-ng multi-core benchmark scoring 2201.38, placing it in the bottom 10%. Uncached memory read and write bandwidths are also low, measuring 22.5 GB/sec and 11.72 GB/sec respectively.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the E2s_v7 provides a high memory density per vCPU for workloads requiring a larger memory footprint without demanding high multi-threaded compute power. It is suitable for lightweight memory-bound applications, single-threaded processing tasks, basic text processing, and small-scale database operations that can leverage Premium Storage.
